judged_text: In sync mode tokenInfo is a raw fetch Response with no .data property, so the unchanged guard if (!tokenInfo.data.error) dereferences undefined. With credential sync enabled, every zoho-bigin token refresh throws a TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)') and the refresh fails; non-sync mode still works because the axios response has .data, so the breakage is specific to the new sync path this diff introduces.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path was changed to `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` but the subsequent code still assumes an Axios response shape: `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`. Per the new helper `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy, it returns the result of `fetch(...)` (a raw `Response` object) which has no `.data` field. That makes `tokenInfo.data` undefined and dereferencing `.error` will throw a `TypeError` in sync mode, while non-sync mode still returns the Axios response with `.data`.
